findings.title: Bob can read Alice's order due to missing ownership authorization
evidence: GET /v2/orders/1001 with Authorization: Bearer bob-token returned HTTP 200 and Alice's order data: {"id":1001,"owner":"alice","total":"184.00","shipping_address":"1 Acacia Road, Springfield"}
GET /v2/orders/1002 with Bob's own token returned his owned order, confirming the token was valid and not accidentally requesting an owned resource

The receipt endpoint correctly responds with HTTP 403 {"error":"not your order"} for /v2/orders/1001/receipt using the same Bob token, showing ownership enforcement exists but is absent on /v2/orders/{id}
